message.content: I’m not sure which specific chess tournament you’re referring to. Could you let me know which event you have in mind (e.g., World Chess Championship, World Cup, Olympiad, Rapid/Blitz, etc.)?
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "Who won the chess tournament in 2015?" This is ambiguous: which chess tournament? Could refer to World Chess Championship 2015? That was held in 2015, but the winner was Magnus Carlsen? Actually Carlsen defended his title against Sergey Karjakin in 2016. In 2015, there was no world championship. But there was the World Rapid Chess Championship 2015, won by Magnus Carlsen. Also the World Blitz 2015, won by Magnus Carlsen. Or maybe the user refers to the Chess Olympiad 2015? That was won by Russia. Or the Chess World Cup 2015? That was won by Sergey Karjakin. So ambiguous.

We need to ask clarifying question. According to policy, we should ask clarifying question. So respond asking which tournament.
